name: openHAB
summary: The state of openHAB items you group by name, such as /oh garage for both garage doors.
description: Reads item states from openHAB's REST API (http://<address>/rest/items/<item>) on your network. You choose which items can be read over the air by putting them in named groups: /oh garage reads every item in the garage group and replies with each one's label and state, and /oh on its own lists your group names. Nothing outside your groups can be read. It signs in with an API token, which you create in openHAB under your profile → API Tokens.
author: MeshHome

settings.label: openHAB address
settings.help: The IP address or hostname of openHAB on your network, with its port (usually 8080). It is read over http://.

settings.label: API token
settings.help: In openHAB, open your profile (bottom of the sidebar) → API Tokens → Create new API token.

settings.label: Item groups
settings.help: One group per line: a name, a colon, then up to 6 item names separated by commas. /oh <name> reads that group. Anyone who can use the bot sees the group names, so name them with that in mind.

reply.empty: openHAB has no state for that group.
